summary: The process-local Claude amendment was rewritten as a saveable, bounded, capability-aware plan. Fifteen plan blockers were resolved and the closing round confirmed an empty frontier.
gaps: The draft lacked Forge's exact required sections, Risks, and a falsifiable Verify Plan.
Surface Impact used unsupported classifications and omitted the canonical surface taxonomy.
T3A applied the capability too late and omitted admission, turn-context, and selecting-repository ownership.
T4 omitted OpenAPI operation and component schema ownership.
The desired-state settings-document typing had no single validation authority.
Claude materialization cleanup conflicted with decision 0010's final temporary-directory teardown.
P1 incorrectly promised live continuation for the inline lane.
Reconstruction proof did not assert that canonical runs/events are retained but not replayed.
Filesystem rollout cleanup had no concrete safe executable or falsifiable tests.
The serial dependency graph contained artificial edges and no per-split boundedness justification.
Backend runtime tasks were incorrectly marked user_facing true.
Runtime PR proof and governing docs were deferred to a later task.
The Anthropic materialization architecture document had no owner.
The recurring contract-partial finding class had no tripwire.
resolutions: The plan now uses all nine exact sections and a command/failure-oriented Verify Plan.
Surface Impact now classifies runtime behavior, API, data/schema, CLI/ops, UI, docs, and tests with supported values.
Capability filtering now starts at turn-context selection before live-execution creates the run, with port/service/repository ownership.
T3D publishes and tests one session.provider.retired event per committed retired row.
T4 owns route metadata, operation schemas, component registration, generation, and integration tests.
The contracts package types the envelope and record-shaped document while the core runtime parser remains the sole full-document authority.
Materialization now has inner session cleanup and final whole-run-directory cleanup per decision 0010, with sentinel proof.
Only the worker MessageStream preserves live continuation; every inline attempt is fresh.
Reconstruction tests explicitly exclude provider transcript, canonical runs, and runtime events from prompt replay.
T3E owns a dry-run/apply Node cleanup helper with allowed-root, symlink, escape, idempotence, and sentinel tests.
Dependencies now name only consumed behavior and every additional task states the bounded-session/review force requiring its split.
All backend tasks are user_facing false while their acceptance contracts still require functional proof where applicable.
Each runtime PR carries its own governing docs and hermetic agent-e2e delta or a concrete non-agent justification.
The Anthropic materialization architecture document is updated with the reconstruction and two-stage cleanup task.
A contract-partial tripwire enumerates producers/consumers and escalates any recurrence under WORKFLOW.md.

rounds.question: The independent plan grill found fifteen blockers. The plan has now been structurally rewritten so: (1) it uses all nine required Forge sections with concrete failure-oriented verification; (2) Surface Impact uses the supported seven-surface taxonomy; (3) process-local filtering happens in turn-context selection before live-execution creates a run and all selection/repository/port files are owned; (4) /new publishes one successful retirement event per committed retired row; (5) T4 owns route metadata, operation schemas, and OpenAPI components; (6) the desired-state DTO is a typed envelope while the core runtime parser remains the sole full-document authority; (7) Claude materialization has inner session cleanup plus final whole-run-directory cleanup per decision 0010; (8) only the worker MessageStream promises live continuation, while inline attempts are fresh; (9) reconstruction tests prove canonical runs/events are retained but not replayed; (10) rollout filesystem cleanup has a concrete dry-run/apply Node helper with allowed-root, symlink, path-escape, idempotence, and sentinel tests; (11) task dependencies now name only real consumed behavior and each extra split states its bounded-review force; (12) every backend task is user_facing false; (13) each runtime PR carries its own canon changes and hermetic agent-e2e delta, or an explicit non-agent justification; (14) the Anthropic materialization architecture document is owned; and (15) a recurring contract-partial tripwire requires producer/consumer enumeration and escalation on recurrence. Confirm these fifteen resolutions and close the plan frontier?
